][27]

ARIA Zero Trust PROTECT (AZT PROTECT™) is a comprehensive AI driven defense system that protects all
your OT endpoints from ALL cybersecurity threats – known and unknown.

This breakthrough patented solution represents a leap forward in the evolution of cybersecurity,
surpassing anything available today. It protects your entire OT device infrastructure and critical
IT applications no matter their location, safeguarding your revenue and reputation. It automatically
blocks virtually all vulnerabilities from exploit at the application and OS level.

### **A Better Approach to Cyber-Attack Detection, Response, and Containment**

][30]
[[Cyber Security Expert]][31]

We took a different path when developing our threat detection and response solutions. Unlike other
providers, we monitor all the network traffic and generate analytics to enable complete
enterprise-wide visibility.

This helps our solutions assist in the identification and disruption of attacks in two important
ways: improve the performance of your existing security stack or deploy automated and full AI-driven
SOC capabilities within a single platform. Customers in a range of industries rely on our solutions
to improve their security posture—no matter their environment.

[Learn More][32]
[

### **AI-SOC Run From the Cloud or On-Premise – The Choice is Yours**

][33]

Our ARIA CloudADR solution is a fully AI-automated, cloud-based virtual SOC that provides an
attractive entry point for companies that need to protect both on-premises and public cloud
infrastructure for pennies on the dollar compared to running a physical SOC. Any ARIA CloudADR can
be upgraded to a full ARIA ADR solution with the deployment of a network-attached platform capable
of detecting and stopping all types of network-borne threats and attacks involving the premises

Both solutions include the equivalent functionality of seven different security tools, all of which
are replaced by more advanced ML-based threat detection models driven by AI. As a result, only
confirmed threats and/or cyber-attacks are presented and stopped in minutes as they become
active—all without human involvement.

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

## From the neighborhood to the nation.

Founded in 1971 in Dearborn, Michigan, ACCESS is the most comprehensive Arab American non-profit
organization in the nation, reaching millions across all backgrounds through its programs, services
and institutions. Our mission is to advance the health, economic, social, and cultural well-being of
all communities regionally and nationwide.

The [Advanced Cybersecurity Management Institute (ACSMI)][90] provides professional cybersecurity
certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

Earn your Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification (ACSMC) through our CPD-accredited and
ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

# Security Services in Nevada
* ## Security Services
  ## in Nevada
  
  American Star Guard is a professional security company based in Las Vegas, Nevada, delivering
  trusted protection for people and property throughout Southern Nevada. Our mission is
  simple—provide dependable, highly trained officers and unmatched client support to keep your
  assets secure and operations uninterrupted.
* ## Proactive Mobile Security Patrols
  
  Our mobile patrol services are a cost-effective way to monitor large properties, parking areas, or
  multiple sites. Marked security vehicles conduct randomized patrols, property checks, and
  after-hours inspections. All patrols are GPS-tracked, time-stamped, and documented digitally for
  full transparency.
* ## Expert Security Officers for Your Protection
  
  Our armed guards are licensed to carry and professionally trained to manage high-risk
  environments. Officers are thoroughly vetted, firearms-certified, and prepared to deter,
  de-escalate, and respond appropriately to potential threats. We follow strict use-of-force
  policies and site-specific protocols to ensure safe, compliant coverage.
* ## Advanced Access Control
  
  Our access control services help regulate who enters and exits your property. From gatehouse
  operations and ID checks to visitor logging and vendor verification, we implement detailed
  protocols that support your safety, privacy, and operational flow. Officers are trained to follow
  your site-specific procedures with professionalism and consistency.

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment
Managed Security

## Our Services

Layanan System Integrator & Cybersecurity yang siap disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan organisasi Anda.

## Our Partners

Kami berkolaborasi dengan partner teknologi untuk menghadirkan solusi System Integrator &

# BIBEK JYOTI ROY

Cybersecurity Expert & Serial Entrepreneur

On a mission to build a secure digital world, empowering individuals and businesses against the
ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats.

## / ABOUT ME

Bibek Jyoti Roy is an Indian cybersecurity expert and entrepreneur. He has made significant
contributions in the fields of programming, bug bounty, penetration testing, and Open Source
Intelligence (OSINT). He has helped many companies, such as IND Money and Phind, identify security
vulnerabilities in their systems. In 2021, he founded Psylinks Security, a company dedicated to
providing advanced cybersecurity solutions, and has since expanded into education, blockchain, open
research, and health & wellness sectors with multiple ventures aimed at creating positive societal
impact.

### Personal

Born: 23 September 2002 (age 22)

Location: Guwahati, Assam, India

Parents: Bijan Roy & Juthika Roy

### Education

Arya Vidyapeeth College

Girijananda Choudhury Institute of Management and Technology, Guwahati

### Organizations Founded

Psylinks Security (2021)

Blockvizion (2023)

Tutoring Point (2024)

Codesity (2025)

Cafel (2025)

### Skills & Expertise

Programming Bug Hunting Penetration Testing OSINT

### Books Written

Play, Click and Learn (2024)

[ Buy on Amazon → ][12]

### / CONNECT

[LinkedIn][13] [Twitter][14] [Mastodon][15] [Pinterest][16] [Instagram][17] [Threads][18]
[Facebook][19]

## / VENTURES

### Psylinks Security

Founded: 2021

An enterprise tech company dedicated to protecting businesses and individuals from cyber threats
through advanced threat detection, data protection, and customized security strategies.

### Blockvizion

Founded: 2023

A forward-thinking venture exploring the applications of blockchain technology to enhance data
security, transparency, and create decentralized solutions for modern digital challenges.

### Tutoring Point

Founded: 2024

An education service startup dedicated to providing high-quality, personalized learning experiences.
Tutoring Point connects students with dedicated educators for tailored home tutoring and academic
support.

### Codesity

Founded: 2025

An independent open research company operating as a fully private, not-for-profit entity. Conducts
rigorous research and development across technology, medicine, food science, and education systems.
All findings and innovations are made freely accessible to society, advancing human knowledge and
wellbeing without commercial constraints or external influence.

### Cafel

Founded: 2025

Guwahati's premier healthy dining destination in Jyotikuchi, offering scientifically-designed meals
that heal and nourish. Features traditional Indian and authentic Assamese cuisine made with 100%
organic, farm-fresh ingredients—no preservatives, chemicals, or refined oils. Every dish is cooked
fresh to order for genuine well-being.

## / VISION

"My vision extends beyond simply reacting to threats. I believe in proactive, intelligent security
that anticipates and neutralizes risks before they can cause harm. We are moving towards a future
where cybersecurity is not a barrier, but an enabler of innovation and trust."

"Through my ventures, we are committed to continuous research and development, staying ahead of the
curve and building a resilient digital infrastructure for the next generation of technology. From
securing digital assets to advancing open scientific research and nourishing physical health, each
venture serves a purpose in creating a better, more equitable tomorrow where knowledge and wellbeing
are accessible to all."

## / CONTACT US

We welcome your feedback, inquiries, and comments. Please feel free to reach out.

### Contact Details

Email: [hi@bibek.co.in][20]

Phone: NA

### Address

Bibek Jyoti Roy
House No 3, Bhaskar Nagar
Sister Nivedita Path, Binovanagar
Kamrup, Assam 781018, India

### Hours

Monday - Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (IST)

The unified platform with one shared view across every IT domain.

Move beyond visibility to autonomous operations with trusted, policy-bound agents that execute

[AI networking]

AI-optimized networking that unifies scale, speed, and resilience—so AI workloads run faster, more
efficiently, and at global scale.

Purpose-built programmable silicon powers networks with leading performance, efficiency, and scale –
optimized for AI workloads across hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers.

[Explore Silicon One][32]
[Sunset over a city skyline with a dense network of glowing lights across the foreground]

Deliver zero-trust segmentation and application protection with a highly-distributed security fabric
and unified management across data center, cloud, campus, and IoT environments.

[Explore Hybrid Mesh Firewall][33]
[Close-up of networking equipment with multiple ports and visible Cisco logo]

### Security fused into the network

Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]
[Close-up of networking equipment featuring Ethernet ports, status LEDs, and network icons]

### The AI-ready platform the edge demands

Redefine edge computing with a full-stack platform that delivers data center performance,
modularity, centralized management, and built-in security where you need it most.

[See the future of the edge][35]

troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

About

## Data Center Map

Launched in 2007, Data Center Map was the first research tool of its kind. We operate a global data
center directory, mapping data center locations worldwide. Our intention is to make it easier for
buyers, sellers, investors, regulators and other professionals working with the industry to gain
insights into the markets of their interest.

## Colocation, Cloud and Connectivity

We cover a wide range of data center services, but our primary focus is colocation, cloud and
connectivity. Our scope extends further, offering insights and statistics on hyperscalers, edge
computing, AI, real estate, network carriers, cloud operators or other digital infrastructure, Data
Center Map is the resource you need.

[Data Center Database][5][Cloud Provider Database][6][Internet Exchange Database][7]

## Procurement & Search Tools

We aim to make it easier for buyers to identify and connect with suitable providers/operators. You
can use our platform to do your own research and contact operators directly. Alternatively, we can
assist with obtaining quotes or guide you through the entire process, from understanding your needs
to finding and engaging with matching providers.

[Get Quotes][8][Free Consultation][9][Data Center Promotions][10]

## Data & Intelligence

We have been tracking the industry since 2007, building one of the most comprehensive databases
available featuring data center locations. We cover power capacity, sizing and many other aspects
relating to supply and demand. If you are looking for a dataset to support your decisions, reach out
to learn more about our datasets available in a wide range of formats (CSV, GeoJSON, KMZ, Shape/SHP)
for integration with your own GIS tools or databases.

[Datasets: Database Exports][11]

## Reach In-Market Buyers

As thousands of visitors are using our database to research colocation, cloud and connectivity
daily, we are a leading channel available for reaching in-market buyers of data center services. We
offer banner advertising, sponsorships, content marketing, enhanced memberships and much more.

# Building for everyone

We build data centers that power essential technology and services as we invest in community
development and lead the industry in data security and sustainability.

[oklahoma-pry-steven-lozano-faith-lanham-2025-1108-rt.webp]

[Link to Youtube Video][27] (visible only when JS is disabled)

We build world-class data centers, providing the essential infrastructure that enables businesses,
governments, and individuals to connect with each other, championing an inclusive and sustainable
future for all.

## Cultivating growth in
## our data center communities

Play Pause

Data centers are the engine for the transition to the digital economy. They link people to a variety
of industries, from supermarkets and retailers to schools and nonprofits.

### Accelerating economies

Together, we are driving increased economic growth, supporting local innovation, and creating career
opportunities within each of our data center communities.

[View our progress][28]

### Workforce development

As a responsible neighbor, we are partnering with, and investing in, our data center communities to
provide sustained support through workforce development, educational opportunities, and other
beneficial initiatives. With inclusive access to AI and digital opportunities, we can better prepare
communities to thrive for generations.

[See how we invest in our neighbors][29]
Play Pause

Google is proud to operate multiple data centers in Northern Virginia — a global hub of the digital
economy — and to support community organizations there that are enabling people and changing lives.
We've collaborated with two inspiring local organizations in the region, Global Inheritance and
Mobile Hope, to introduce more young women to science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) and
to combat youth homelessness.

Play Pause

In Hamina, Finland, where Google has a data center, we are working with city-owned energy provider
Haminan Energia to kick off our first offsite heat recovery project to reduce our environmental
footprint, as well as help warm homes and businesses in this historic port city.

### Expanding access

Each day, we build for a tomorrow where everyone can benefit. We strengthen community connections by
investing in local initiatives like sustainability programs for young children. We enhance digital
integration with projects like rural internet connectivity. And we spark economic opportunities by
providing high-paying jobs through our infrastructure projects.

[See how we build for tomorrow][30]

## Building toward a more
## sustainable future

### We harness technology to spur positive environmental change

We aspire to build the most efficient computing systems, while caring for water resources and making
energy grids strong. We work with communities to ensure we responsibly power the products and
services our communities rely on.

[Discover how we’re operating sustainably][31]
[A team of solar panel installers work together on placing a panel into place on a solar farm in
Fredericia, Denmark, in collaboration with our data center.]

The Rødby Fjord solar project adds clean energy to the grid that powers our data center in
Fredericia, Denmark.

## Ensuring your data is
## safer and more secure

[A technician troubleshoots an issue between a row of servers in our The Dalles, Oregon, data
center.]

Denise inspects a central processing unit (CPU) at one of our data centers.

### We design our data centers with security in mind

Security is part of our data centers’ DNA. We custom build servers exclusively for our data centers,
and our industry-leading security team works 24/7 around the globe, making our facilities one of the
safest places for your data to live.

[See how we safeguard your data][32]

Powerful AI starts with infrastructure. Build the base for sustained workloads, then rent the spike
as demand surges.

[Explore our AI solutions][99]

## Everything depends on the right infrastructure.

Modern workloads are moving faster and getting more complex. Our global data center platform,
PlatformDIGITAL®, delivers scalable colocation and secure interconnection that help you deploy
faster, reduce risk, and turn infrastructure into a competitive edge.

[Start scaling smarter][100]
Cloud needs a solid foundation. Exit fees and vendor lock-in make it hard to stay agile. You need
infrastructure that adapts—without compromise.
AI is exposing infrastructure gaps. Inference loads and GPU demands are pushing traditional
environments to their limits. AI is evolving fast—your infrastructure can’t lag. 
Compliance isn’t optional.Data sovereignty, security, and privacy regulations are redrawing the
enterprise map. Protect what matters—wherever your business runs.
Remote teams run on connectivity.Your teams work everywhere. They need fast, secure access to the
apps and data that keep your business moving.

licensed armed security officers, mobile patrol, fire watch, and executive protection across
Northern Virginia and Maryland. Founded by Marine Corps veteran Tevan White, our officers come from
law enforcement and military backgrounds with DCJS licensing and continuous training.

### Immutable.

### Independent.

### Intelligent.

Keepit stores backup data separately from production data. Immutable by design and always available,
helping you stay resilient now and in the future. That’s intelligent.

[Why Keepit][86][The Keepit platform][87]

#### Make the intelligent choice 

## Independent cloud for resilience and recovery 

While you may think your SaaS provider offers backup and recovery, that's actually your
responsibility. 

 

Manage resilience and retain control when faced with emerging technologies and the rise of
artificial intelligence (AI). Future-proof your data protection and ensure compliance with Keepit’s
independent cloud.

[Explore use cases][88]

## Your data. Here today.
## Here tomorrow. 

#### **Resilience against data loss** 

Immutable protection for fast, reliable recovery - maintain control of your data and eliminate risk
while embracing new technologies.

#### **Independent cloud backup** 

Certified end-to-end with no third-party sub-processors: Keepit’s air-gapped architecture ensures
resilient recovery. 

#### **Easy and reliable data compliance** 

ISO 27001, ISAE 3402 certified. Stay compliant with GDPR, HIPAA, NIS2, NIST, and other global
regulations. 

## World Tour

Resilience starts with intelligent choices

Together, we will connect, empower, and protect. Join us in a city near you.

[Sign up][89]

#### Explore Keepit’s platform 

## Effortless SaaS data management 

Keepit’s platform streamlines data protection with a single, intuitive dashboard across Microsoft
365, Salesforce, and more.  

 

Flat-rate pricing and unlimited always-hot data storage eliminates hidden costs, while our immutable
backup ensures resilience by keeping data secure, air-gapped, and always accessible. 

[Explore the platform][90]

#### Resilience against data loss 

## Air gapped for confident recovery 

Keepit offers unmatched security against data loss or ransomware attacks. By isolating backups, we
ensure full data integrity. With immutable backups and rapid recovery to a known-good-state, Keepit
enables resilience and gives you peace of mind when exploring advanced technologies, including AI.

[Keepit for disaster recovery][91]

#### Ensure business continuity 

## Easily enforce and document compliance  

With no third-party sub-processors and a no-transfer guarantee, Keepit’s independent cloud ensures
compliance with frameworks like NIS2, DORA, GDPR, HIPAA, and NIST. Support for internal policies,
audit-ready documentation, and customizable retention periods up to 99 years give you complete
control. Your data remains secure, private, and sovereign in your choice of 7 global regions.

## Database building for structured business records

**Microsoft Access** is a database builder for teams that outgrow spreadsheets but do not need a
full server setup. It stores information in **Relational tables** and lets users retrieve it with
**Query design**, so lists become searchable records that can be reused across projects. The logic
stays visible, making reviews easier.

**Microsoft Access** also supports fast data capture through a **Form builder** and consistent
outputs via **Report templates**. It works well for [inventory][187], [contacts][188], and
**internal tracking** where accuracy matters, though it still rewards careful planning when multiple
people touch the same file. Sharing works best when structure stays consistent.

### Turning records into a maintainable database

Microsoft Access shines when a team needs structured records with rules, not just freeform cells.
Using the **Relationships window**, it can connect records so one change updates everywhere, and
**Primary key enforcement** helps prevent duplicates. **Validation rules** keep entries within
expected ranges, which reduces cleanup later. That structure is a big plus for audits and repeatable
reporting, but it also means the [database][189] must be designed up front, or edits get messy as
requirements shift. It works best for departmental apps where ownership is clear and data
definitions stay stable.

# Smart System Integration Services at Operational Intelligence

Operational Intelligence is a leading system integration service partner that empowers
decision-makers to optimise the full lifecycle of infrastructure, precincts, and nation-defining
projects. We focus on driving performance, reducing costs, and delivering measurable outcomes for
lasting impact.

[ Learn More ][21]

## The OI Value

We are partners of choice for Advisory & Integration of best-of-breed technology, including 3rd
party, Digital Experience, Master System Integration (MSI), Services, On-Premise, Cloud & Hybrid
Technologies. We bring deep expertise in co-innovation and co-creation of system infrastructure and
integration solutions with customers and develop end-to-end solutions in collaboration with
partners.

### Maximised Returns

Maximize your returns by optimizing energy efficiency, reduced maintenance costs and improving
occupant comfort. Our smart building solutions provide the insights that identify areas for
improvement, so building owners can enhance all ranges of their operations. With our real-time data
analytics and centralized dashboards, we ensure minimal waste and maximized performance.

### Increased Efficiency

Our smart building solutions are designed to optimize energy consumption, reduce maintenance costs
and enhance operational performance. Access simplified data analytics that lets you monitor and
regulate HVAC systems, lighting, security, room bookings, lifts, parking and more.

### Comfortable Occupants

Through leveraging IoT sensors and data analytics, our solutions can optimise indoor air quality,
temperature, lighting and other factors to enhance occupant comfort. This can lead to higher tenant
satisfaction and better retention rates. Our solutions provide essential tools for building a
positive reputation and attracting and retaining tenants.

## What We Offer

### Network System Integration

Operational Intelligence is responsible for designing networks, server solutions, wifi solutions and
cyber security strategies. Within these solutions we can tailor to a clients needs based on
different requirements including brands, levels of redundancy and scalability for future.

[ Learn More ][33]
[what we offer image][what we offer image]

### Digital Advisory

We live and breathe technology from R&D through to delivery and support making us a partner of
choice to deliver more sustainable and profitable digital building solutions.

The digital advisory is a key step to understanding the needs of our customers and transforming
these needs into a digital strategy and then a digital roadmap for deployment.

[ Learn More ][34]
[Digital Advisory][Digital Advisory]

### Master System Integrator

Operational Intelligence uses advanced knowledge of industry standards and best practises to
seamlessly integrate multiple building systems and subsystems in a cohesive and interoperable whole.
Utilising digital workflows and dashboarding, building owners can monitor multiple systems to
enhance user interoperability and building operations. These systems can include HVAC, lighting,
security, fire safety, access control and energy management systems.

[ Learn More ][35]

compression, and authenticated encryption.

remotes, see health and performance at a glance, and coordinate key operations across clusters and
data centers.

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

## Statement

## Transparency is our policy

It is important that our users know what information we collect and why, and how it’s used. Being
explicitly clear about our data practice by making the information accessible and understandable, we
help you make informed decisions as you use our products and services.We also publicly publish our
Transparency Report
.

## Control of your data

At Xiaomi, we believe users should stay informed and in control when it comes to privacy. The
control over your data always remains an individual choice that belongs only to you. We will only
collect your data with your consent. You can request to access, correct or delete the information
collected in
Privacy Support
at any time.

## Keep your data secure

Your data is secured by our security protection mechanisms which are tested and certified by the
world's leading experts. Your data is transmitted by the encrypted communication channels and stored
in global top-tier cloud providers.

## Supporting global privacy compliance

Privacy and security protection have always been the key concepts of our product design. We devote
ourselves to establishing a standardized, and progressive privacy impact assessment procedure to
ensure that our products and services are compliant with data protection laws and regulations.

## Innovating trustworthy AI

We believe that AI technology enhances and enriches user experience of our consumer electronic
products. We are currently using AI algorithms in four areas of application in our devices: camera
image optimization, voice communication noise reduction, fingerprint and face unlocking. Our AI
algorithms never transmit any user data. All AI algorithms in these four areas of application run on
your local device, and all data processed by these AI algorithms is stored on your local device
only.

## No data will be uploaded under Mi Browser incognito mode

Mi Browser is a chromium-based web browser. We won't record the sites you visit, the keywords your
searched and any other data when the incognito mode is enabled.

## * We store user data in top-tier cloud providers, including Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, etc.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is computing investment different from crypto mining?

Computing investment is about renting computing power for real-world use cases like AI training and
scientific computing. Revenue comes from enterprise clients' leasing fees. This is fundamentally
different from crypto mining — our revenue model is based on real commercial demand and long-term
contracts, not token price fluctuations.

What is the minimum investment threshold?

We offer tiered plans starting from ¥99,000 for the Starter. The Pro plan suits high-net-worth
clients, while the Enterprise plan is customized to your specific needs. All plans provide
transparent return expectations and risk disclosures.

How is my computing asset secured?

All computing equipment is deployed in our T3+ certified data center with 24/7 security, fire
suppression, and climate control systems. We also provide asset insurance, real-time monitoring
dashboards, and regular audit reports. Contracts clearly define asset ownership to ensure your
rights are legally protected.

How are returns calculated and distributed?

Returns are calculated based on the actual rental of your hosted computing resources, accumulated
daily and settled monthly. You can monitor utilization rates, revenue details, and settlement
progress in real-time through your dedicated dashboard. We offer bank transfers, USDT, and other
settlement methods.

Can I visit the data center in person?

Absolutely. We organize regular customer tours where you can see the scale and operational standards
of our super factory firsthand. Professional plan and above customers enjoy complimentary quarterly
visits. Starter plan customers can schedule paid visits. Please contact your account manager in
advance to arrange your trip.

certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

  your site-specific procedures with professionalism and consistency.

# BIBEK JYOTI ROY

Cybersecurity Expert & Serial Entrepreneur

On a mission to build a secure digital world, empowering individuals and businesses against the
ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats.

## / ABOUT ME

Bibek Jyoti Roy is an Indian cybersecurity expert and entrepreneur. He has made significant
contributions in the fields of programming, bug bounty, penetration testing, and Open Source
Intelligence (OSINT). He has helped many companies, such as IND Money and Phind, identify security
vulnerabilities in their systems. In 2021, he founded Psylinks Security, a company dedicated to
providing advanced cybersecurity solutions, and has since expanded into education, blockchain, open
research, and health & wellness sectors with multiple ventures aimed at creating positive societal
impact.

### Personal

Born: 23 September 2002 (age 22)

Location: Guwahati, Assam, India

Parents: Bijan Roy & Juthika Roy

### Education

Arya Vidyapeeth College

Girijananda Choudhury Institute of Management and Technology, Guwahati

### Organizations Founded

Psylinks Security (2021)

Blockvizion (2023)

Tutoring Point (2024)

Codesity (2025)

Cafel (2025)

### Skills & Expertise

Programming Bug Hunting Penetration Testing OSINT

### Books Written

Play, Click and Learn (2024)

[ Buy on Amazon → ][12]

### / CONNECT

[LinkedIn][13] [Twitter][14] [Mastodon][15] [Pinterest][16] [Instagram][17] [Threads][18]
[Facebook][19]

## / VENTURES

### Psylinks Security

Founded: 2021

An enterprise tech company dedicated to protecting businesses and individuals from cyber threats
through advanced threat detection, data protection, and customized security strategies.

### Blockvizion

Founded: 2023

A forward-thinking venture exploring the applications of blockchain technology to enhance data
security, transparency, and create decentralized solutions for modern digital challenges.

### Tutoring Point

Founded: 2024

An education service startup dedicated to providing high-quality, personalized learning experiences.
Tutoring Point connects students with dedicated educators for tailored home tutoring and academic
support.

### Codesity

Founded: 2025

An independent open research company operating as a fully private, not-for-profit entity. Conducts
rigorous research and development across technology, medicine, food science, and education systems.
All findings and innovations are made freely accessible to society, advancing human knowledge and
wellbeing without commercial constraints or external influence.

### Cafel

Founded: 2025

Guwahati's premier healthy dining destination in Jyotikuchi, offering scientifically-designed meals
that heal and nourish. Features traditional Indian and authentic Assamese cuisine made with 100%
organic, farm-fresh ingredients—no preservatives, chemicals, or refined oils. Every dish is cooked
fresh to order for genuine well-being.

## / VISION

"My vision extends beyond simply reacting to threats. I believe in proactive, intelligent security
that anticipates and neutralizes risks before they can cause harm. We are moving towards a future
where cybersecurity is not a barrier, but an enabler of innovation and trust."

"Through my ventures, we are committed to continuous research and development, staying ahead of the
curve and building a resilient digital infrastructure for the next generation of technology. From
securing digital assets to advancing open scientific research and nourishing physical health, each
venture serves a purpose in creating a better, more equitable tomorrow where knowledge and wellbeing
are accessible to all."

## / CONTACT US

We welcome your feedback, inquiries, and comments. Please feel free to reach out.

About

## Data Center Map

Launched in 2007, Data Center Map was the first research tool of its kind. We operate a global data
center directory, mapping data center locations worldwide. Our intention is to make it easier for
buyers, sellers, investors, regulators and other professionals working with the industry to gain
insights into the markets of their interest.

## Colocation, Cloud and Connectivity

We cover a wide range of data center services, but our primary focus is colocation, cloud and
connectivity. Our scope extends further, offering insights and statistics on hyperscalers, edge
computing, AI, real estate, network carriers, cloud operators or other digital infrastructure, Data
Center Map is the resource you need.

[Data Center Database][5][Cloud Provider Database][6][Internet Exchange Database][7]

## Procurement & Search Tools

We aim to make it easier for buyers to identify and connect with suitable providers/operators. You
can use our platform to do your own research and contact operators directly. Alternatively, we can
assist with obtaining quotes or guide you through the entire process, from understanding your needs
to finding and engaging with matching providers.

[Get Quotes][8][Free Consultation][9][Data Center Promotions][10]

## Data & Intelligence

We have been tracking the industry since 2007, building one of the most comprehensive databases
available featuring data center locations. We cover power capacity, sizing and many other aspects
relating to supply and demand. If you are looking for a dataset to support your decisions, reach out
to learn more about our datasets available in a wide range of formats (CSV, GeoJSON, KMZ, Shape/SHP)
for integration with your own GIS tools or databases.

[Datasets: Database Exports][11]

## Reach In-Market Buyers

As thousands of visitors are using our database to research colocation, cloud and connectivity
daily, we are a leading channel available for reaching in-market buyers of data center services. We
offer banner advertising, sponsorships, content marketing, enhanced memberships and much more.

About

## Data Center Map

Launched in 2007, Data Center Map was the first research tool of its kind. We operate a global data
center directory, mapping data center locations worldwide. Our intention is to make it easier for
buyers, sellers, investors, regulators and other professionals working with the industry to gain
insights into the markets of their interest.

## Colocation, Cloud and Connectivity

We cover a wide range of data center services, but our primary focus is colocation, cloud and
connectivity. Our scope extends further, offering insights and statistics on hyperscalers, edge
computing, AI, real estate, network carriers, cloud operators or other digital infrastructure, Data
Center Map is the resource you need.

[Data Center Database][5][Cloud Provider Database][6][Internet Exchange Database][7]

## Procurement & Search Tools

We aim to make it easier for buyers to identify and connect with suitable providers/operators. You
can use our platform to do your own research and contact operators directly. Alternatively, we can
assist with obtaining quotes or guide you through the entire process, from understanding your needs
to finding and engaging with matching providers.

[Get Quotes][8][Free Consultation][9][Data Center Promotions][10]

## Data & Intelligence

We have been tracking the industry since 2007, building one of the most comprehensive databases
available featuring data center locations. We cover power capacity, sizing and many other aspects
relating to supply and demand. If you are looking for a dataset to support your decisions, reach out
to learn more about our datasets available in a wide range of formats (CSV, GeoJSON, KMZ, Shape/SHP)
for integration with your own GIS tools or databases.

[Datasets: Database Exports][11]

## Reach In-Market Buyers

As thousands of visitors are using our database to research colocation, cloud and connectivity
daily, we are a leading channel available for reaching in-market buyers of data center services. We
offer banner advertising, sponsorships, content marketing, enhanced memberships and much more.

[Providers: Reach In-Market Buyers][12]

# Building for everyone

We build data centers that power essential technology and services as we invest in community
development and lead the industry in data security and sustainability.

[oklahoma-pry-steven-lozano-faith-lanham-2025-1108-rt.webp]

[Link to Youtube Video][27] (visible only when JS is disabled)

We build world-class data centers, providing the essential infrastructure that enables businesses,
governments, and individuals to connect with each other, championing an inclusive and sustainable
future for all.

## Cultivating growth in
## our data center communities

Play Pause

Data centers are the engine for the transition to the digital economy. They link people to a variety
of industries, from supermarkets and retailers to schools and nonprofits.

### Accelerating economies

Together, we are driving increased economic growth, supporting local innovation, and creating career
opportunities within each of our data center communities.

[View our progress][28]

### Workforce development

As a responsible neighbor, we are partnering with, and investing in, our data center communities to
provide sustained support through workforce development, educational opportunities, and other
beneficial initiatives. With inclusive access to AI and digital opportunities, we can better prepare
communities to thrive for generations.

[See how we invest in our neighbors][29]
Play Pause

Google is proud to operate multiple data centers in Northern Virginia — a global hub of the digital
economy — and to support community organizations there that are enabling people and changing lives.
We've collaborated with two inspiring local organizations in the region, Global Inheritance and
Mobile Hope, to introduce more young women to science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) and
to combat youth homelessness.

Play Pause

In Hamina, Finland, where Google has a data center, we are working with city-owned energy provider
Haminan Energia to kick off our first offsite heat recovery project to reduce our environmental
footprint, as well as help warm homes and businesses in this historic port city.

### Expanding access

Each day, we build for a tomorrow where everyone can benefit. We strengthen community connections by
investing in local initiatives like sustainability programs for young children. We enhance digital
integration with projects like rural internet connectivity. And we spark economic opportunities by
providing high-paying jobs through our infrastructure projects.

[See how we build for tomorrow][30]

## Building toward a more
## sustainable future

### We harness technology to spur positive environmental change

We aspire to build the most efficient computing systems, while caring for water resources and making
energy grids strong. We work with communities to ensure we responsibly power the products and
services our communities rely on.

[Discover how we’re operating sustainably][31]
[A team of solar panel installers work together on placing a panel into place on a solar farm in
Fredericia, Denmark, in collaboration with our data center.]

The Rødby Fjord solar project adds clean energy to the grid that powers our data center in
Fredericia, Denmark.

## Ensuring your data is
## safer and more secure

[A technician troubleshoots an issue between a row of servers in our The Dalles, Oregon, data
center.]

Denise inspects a central processing unit (CPU) at one of our data centers.

### We design our data centers with security in mind

Security is part of our data centers’ DNA. We custom build servers exclusively for our data centers,
and our industry-leading security team works 24/7 around the globe, making our facilities one of the
safest places for your data to live.

[See how we safeguard your data][32]

## What HostDir is, and why we built it this way.

Web infrastructure moves fast. Networks rearrange peering, registrars rotate ownership, data centers
open and close, BGP routes shift inside minutes. Keeping track of it while doing your day job is not
a small ask. We built HostDir to be the reference desk for the people who run the modern web.

The site you are reading is an editorial publication first. We run a news desk, we write long-form
pillar guides on the protocols and services that hold the internet together, and we maintain a
working directory of the hosting providers, data centers, networks and domain extensions you might
actually need. Free tools, no paywall, no signup. The hosting marketplace is one section of the

### Turning records into a maintainable database

Microsoft Access shines when a team needs structured records with rules, not just freeform cells.

reporting, but it also means the [database][189] must be designed up front, or edits get messy as
requirements shift. It works best for departmental apps where ownership is clear and data

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is computing investment different from crypto mining?

Computing investment is about renting computing power for real-world use cases like AI training and
scientific computing. Revenue comes from enterprise clients' leasing fees. This is fundamentally
different from crypto mining — our revenue model is based on real commercial demand and long-term
contracts, not token price fluctuations.

What is the minimum investment threshold?

We offer tiered plans starting from ¥99,000 for the Starter. The Pro plan suits high-net-worth
clients, while the Enterprise plan is customized to your specific needs. All plans provide
transparent return expectations and risk disclosures.

How is my computing asset secured?

All computing equipment is deployed in our T3+ certified data center with 24/7 security, fire
suppression, and climate control systems. We also provide asset insurance, real-time monitoring
dashboards, and regular audit reports. Contracts clearly define asset ownership to ensure your
rights are legally protected.

How are returns calculated and distributed?

Returns are calculated based on the actual rental of your hosted computing resources, accumulated
daily and settled monthly. You can monitor utilization rates, revenue details, and settlement
progress in real-time through your dedicated dashboard. We offer bank transfers, USDT, and other
settlement methods.

Can I visit the data center in person?

Absolutely. We organize regular customer tours where you can see the scale and operational standards
of our super factory firsthand. Professional plan and above customers enjoy complimentary quarterly
visits. Starter plan customers can schedule paid visits. Please contact your account manager in
advance to arrange your trip.
